record.body:
## Orientation

Territory: dashboard/ and scripts/dashboard*.py (and related dashboard tests: tests/test_dashboard_app.py dismiss pilots; README if documenting signer). Do not edit skills/*.md — concurrent task skill-needs-clear owns those.

Worktree (code writes only): /home/andrewyin/se-workflow--needs-you-close
Do not edit .artifacts/. Do not call adaptive-artifacts except as the product under test (subprocess stubs / temp store in tests). Return the evidence block only.

Note: existing constraint dashboard-read-only said the dashboard never writes; decision dashboard-cli-writes explicitly allows dismiss via adaptive-artifacts CLI. Implement dismiss through CLI only; do not invent a local dismiss cache.

Verify with: uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k dismiss

### Requirements (R4, R5)

R4: From the Needs you list or detail, the dashboard can dismiss the same human-dismissible kinds by invoking adaptive-artifacts CLI with the same transitions as the skills; loop-route, integration, and merge-branch items are not dismissible there.

R5: After a successful dismiss or skill clear, Needs you no longer shows that item on the next store refresh; failed CLI writes leave the item open and surface an error.

### Design Invariants

No dashboard-local dismiss cache. Human-dismissible set is questions + needs-human + unsigned-check only. Skill and dashboard clears are CLI-equivalent outcomes.

### Design Assumptions

adaptive-artifacts available to the dashboard process. Signer identity for manual checks is available (config, env, or short prompt).

### Decisions

- dismiss-human-gates: dismiss questions, needs:human findings, and unsigned manual checks only
- dashboard-cli-writes: dashboard dismiss via adaptive-artifacts CLI
